source: Excel Mac UI in a new scratch workbook; A1:B2 Merge & Center, Format Cells > Border > Dotted > Outline > Diagonal Up
observations: The merged A1:B2 has four distinct cell style references, one for each corner's outer edges; every corner's border also carries diagonalUp and dotted diagonal.
After unmerging and Save As, mergeCells is removed but A1/B1/A2/B2 style references and border definitions remain unchanged.
In Excel Mac Format Cells, Inside, Horizontal and Vertical border controls are disabled when the merged A1:B2 selection is active; outer edges and diagonals remain enabled.
